notes.title: Farming Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=bNHkQUwB1Mk;full][/previewyoutube]

New:


 Farming!
 You can now purchase checkouts from the lumberjack and change their position
 You can now view item amounts in your slot.
 New expansions (market and farming areas)
 New licenses
 New lights (for walls and ceilings)
 New weather variations for the seasons
 New background music
 Sensitivity settings


Changed:


 Revamped in-game economy from scratch
 Customer satisfaction now affects reputation value more
 Orderable products updated according to their licenses
 New control hints added for clarity
 Easter is postponed by 1 day to allow players to prepare
 Clients are disconnected if their version does not match with the host
 Disconnect reasons are shown in the menu


Fixed:


 Fixed a bug that caused random player movement for some users (special thanks to vitrexer)
 Adjusted hint orders to avoid softlocks
 The game over screen menu button now works
 Day cycle is now frozen on the client after nighttime
 Prevented multiple sleep actions due to client-side lag
 Disconnected clients are now sent to the menu

notes.title: Update Notes for 0.4.0
notes.notes:
-Updated the order screen to display the goods' amount
-Added a detail text feature to provide information on empty items or remaining decay time
-Improved customer AI behavior
-Sleep anytime when the market is closed so you can have more control over how you spend your time (customers in the market will get everything for free if you don't finish checkout)
-Pressing ESC now hides the tooltip
-Fixed minor bugs and issues.
